G01a_cancel_during_core.claim: CANCELLED is shown only after the daemon and kernel agree no backend of this job exists.
G01a_cancel_during_core.expected: at first CANCELLED observation: zero backend processes, zero running invocation containers; no completion marker
G01a_cancel_during_core.failure_hypothesis: GUI shows CANCELLED while a container is still running or a CRISPResso process is alive.

G01b_inspect_after_cancel_with_nonempty_.claim: A run cancelled during Core with genuine nonempty partial CRISPResso output is resumable in place (v1.0.0 F-01).
G01b_inspect_after_cancel_with_nonempty_.expected: RESUMABLE, executable, no removal paths; partial output retained outside the workspace
G01b_inspect_after_cancel_with_nonempty_.failure_hypothesis: Partial output blocks recovery or is labelled TAMPERED/UNSUPPORTED.

G01c_repeated_cancel_and_recovery_then_s.claim: Repeated cancellation and recovery ends in a verified result equal to the designed truth; retained attempts are never adopted or deleted.
G01c_repeated_cancel_and_recovery_then_s.expected: second cancel CANCELLED+contained; RESUMABLE again; COMPLETED; independent oracle passes; attempt directories byte-identical
G01c_repeated_cancel_and_recovery_then_s.failure_hypothesis: Second cancel breaks recovery; recovered numbers differ; earlier attempt directories are reused or removed.

G02_supervisor_SIGKILL.claim: SIGKILL of the supervisor cannot leave or later start an uncontrolled CRISPResso, and never yields COMPLETED.
G02_supervisor_SIGKILL.expected: all backend processes gone within 5 s; no CRISPResso ever starts again; job FAILED and stays FAILED; no completion marker
G02_supervisor_SIGKILL.failure_hypothesis: Backend survives the supervisor; or the orphaned scientific worker launches further backend runs; or the job is reported successful.

error.detail: The host worker lease remains held; supervisor exit is not proof of cleanup.
error.message: Scientific process containment could not be confirmed.

error.detail: BACKEND_EXECUTION_FAILED [metrics::1A::T1]: Sample 1A, target T1: backend could not analyse the reads. Inspect execution_failures.json in the retained metrics attempt. Check read quality, mate overlap and sample selection in Setup/Review; no sample was omitted.

G05_daemon_frozen_during_cancel.claim: With the daemon unreachable, containment stays unconfirmed (no CANCELLED), yet the guard still stops Core; confirmation resumes when the daemon returns.
G05_daemon_frozen_during_cancel.expected: job never CANCELLED while frozen; kernel shows backend gone anyway; after resume: CANCELLED with clean independent state
G05_daemon_frozen_during_cancel.failure_hypothesis: CANCELLED is announced without daemon proof; or the backend keeps running because the daemon is needed to stop it.

G06_forged_session_record.claim: Session records authorize observation only: a forged record naming an unrelated running container can delay confirmation but can never kill or remove that container.
G06_forged_session_record.expected: job stays unconfirmed while the forged record exists; unrelated container untouched; own backend already gone; CANCELLED after the record is removed
G06_forged_session_record.failure_hypothesis: Supervisor kills/removes the unrelated container, or confirms containment while a registered container runs.
G06_forged_session_record.note: A same-account writer can therefore hold the host lease indefinitely (fail-closed denial of service), and could equally hide a container by pointing a record at another socket; both require code execution as the user, outside the stated boundary.
